title: AiCreationList
description: ai.creation-list@1: the answer of GET /api/v1/creations on OpenVibe.AI — every thing AI can make that is live now, built from the registered workflows and tasks rather than a hand-kept list. The endpoint is public, cached for five minutes and answers any origin (Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *). The same catalogue is rendered as Markdown at GET /api/v1/creations.md and listed in GET /llms.txt.

creations.description: Live creations, ordered by product and then by name.

count.description: Number of creations in this response.

generated_at.description: When this answer was built from the registry.
